ammonia.reason: Limited amino acid deamination and urease activity in low-moisture cooked paste.

animal_barnyard.reason: Very low p-cresol/indole from clean pasteurized cow milk with no smear flora.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin balanced by starter peptidase debittering.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and Lys from proteolysis during dry heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by mesophilic starter plus delta-lactones from fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic/hexanoic/octanoic acids from pregastric and microbial lipase lipolysis during aging.

creaminess.reason: High 37.2% fat but low 27.8% moisture firm matrix limits mouth-coating fat release.

crumbliness.reason: Low-moisture proteolyzed paracasein with tyrosine crystals giving granular fracture.

firmness.reason: Cooked whey expulsion to 27.8% moisture plus calcium-phosphate crosslinked casein, 26N firmness.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from Phe catabolism plus alpine pasture terpenes.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterase esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Absent 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids as 100% cow milk cheese.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-methylpropanal/2- and 3-methylbutanal from Val/Leu/Ile plus cooking.

melt.reason: Rennet pH 5.59 network flows but aged low moisture and high protein restrict flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one without white/blue mold lipoxygenase pathway.

oil_off.reason: Coalesced fat globules from cooked high-fat matrix leak free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking and no guaiacol/phenol formation.

sour_vinegar.reason: Low acetic/propanoic acid, lactose converted to lactic and buffered at pH 5.59.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, calcium-bound casein does not align.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methional/dimethyl sulfide/disulfide after pasteurization heat dissipates with aging.

sweet.reason: Glycerol plus sweet amino acids Ala/Pro/Gly and low sour enhancing sweet perception.

umami.reason: High glutamate from extensive proteolysis with WSN ~9% by rennet/plasmin and peptidases.
